title: Full decomposition tree for a system
description: Returns the full hardware decomposition hierarchy: system, subsystem, component, sub-component, element.

title: All components with their manufacturer and architecture
description: Returns components with label, manufacturer, architecture, and package type.

title: All vulnerabilities ranked by CVSS score
description: Returns all vulnerabilities with entity, CVSS score, CWE mapping, and patch status.

title: High-severity unpatched vulnerabilities
description: Returns vulnerabilities with CVSS >= 7.0 that have no patch available.

title: Vulnerabilities with no countermeasure
description: Returns vulnerabilities that have no associated countermeasure.

title: Vulnerabilities with public exploits but no patch
description: Returns vulnerabilities that have a known exploit but no vendor patch.

title: Remotely exploitable attack surfaces
description: Returns attack surfaces that can be exploited without physical access.

title: Unauthenticated remote attack surfaces (highest risk)
description: Returns remotely exploitable attack surfaces that require no authentication.

title: Attack surfaces mapped to MITRE ATT&CK techniques
description: Returns attack surfaces with their associated ATT&CK and CAPEC mappings.

title: Unlocked or bypassable debug interfaces
description: Returns debug interfaces that are unlocked or have known bypass techniques.

title: Physical interfaces accessible without probing
description: Returns physical interfaces that don't require probing or soldering to access.

title: Trust boundaries with known bypasses
description: Returns trust boundaries that have known bypass techniques with optional CVE references.

title: Interfaces that cross trust boundaries
description: Returns interfaces that cross trust boundaries with protocol and enforcement mechanism.

title: Firmware without signature verification
description: Returns firmware that lacks cryptographic signature verification.

title: Firmware missing security-hardening compiler flags
description: Returns firmware binaries missing stack-protector, FORTIFY_SOURCE, or PIE compiler flags.
query:
PREFIX hw:   <https://trustgraph.ai/ontology/hwsec/hw#>
PREFIX sec:  <https://trustgraph.ai/ontology/hwsec/sec#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl:  <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd:  <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT ?entity ?entityLabel ?fw ?flags
WHERE {
  ?entity hw:hasFirmware ?fw ;
          rdfs:label ?entityLabel .
  ?fw hw:compilerFlags ?flags .
  FILTER(
    !CONTAINS(?flags, "stack-protector") ||
    !CONTAINS(?flags, "FORTIFY_SOURCE") ||
    !CONTAINS(?flags, "PIE")
  )
}

title: Remotely reachable network interfaces without encryption
description: Returns network interfaces that are remotely reachable but lack encryption.

title: Network interfaces reachable without authentication
description: Returns remotely reachable network interfaces that don't require authentication.

title: High-impact threat scenarios and the vulnerabilities they exploit
description: Returns HIGH or CRITICAL impact threat models with their exploited vulnerabilities.

title: Threat scenarios vs. deployed countermeasures (gap analysis)
description: Returns threat scenarios with their exploited vulnerabilities and any countermeasures, for gap analysis.

title: Countermeasures mapped to MITRE D3FEND
description: Returns countermeasures with their D3FEND technique mappings and effectiveness.

title: Recommended but not yet implemented countermeasures
description: Returns countermeasures that are recommended but not deployed, with cost and vulnerability context.

title: Shared sub-components (cross-domain attack potential)
description: Returns sub-components shared between multiple trust domains.

title: Components past end-of-life with known vulnerabilities
description: Returns end-of-life components that have known vulnerabilities.

title: Low trust-level entities with network-facing interfaces
description: Returns entities with trust level <= 1 that have remotely reachable network interfaces.
